{{DISPLAYTITLE:Goblin (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-spr-Goblin.gif|left]]
[[File:FFTA Goblin.jpg|right]]
{{Quote|Cretins with big ears and fangs. Strong and stupid.|Description}}
'''Goblin''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is the first race of enemies encountered. Goblins are blue, in contrast to their stronger counterparts, the [[Red Cap (Tactics Advance)|Red Caps]]. While they make for an interesting battle, Goblins are usually easy to defeat and are considered the weakest enemy in the game.

Goblins are found in at least one mission in almost every one of the earlier locations, but cannot be encountered again after the early missions are completed ([[#Extinction|see below]]). Their attack, [[Goblin Punch]], misses often, but when it does hit the target, it usually inflicts only a small amount of damage. Goblin Punch is learnable as [[Blue Magic (Tactics Advance)|Blue Magic]], but due to its inconsistency and weakness, it is more of a trophy ability.

==Extinction==
[[File:FFTA Goblin Portrait.gif|Portrait.|right]]
Fairly early on, Goblins will become "extinct", meaning they do not show up in any mission after the six listed above. Thus it is important to capture a Goblin and to teach all of the [[human]] members of the player's [[clan]] Goblin Punch as early as possible. This can be bypassed by simply avoiding to complete one of the missions, effectively letting players complete the storyline and still be able to battle Goblins afterwards. This can be a good idea, if one wishes to [[Level grinding|level up]] their characters, have them learn more abilities and possibly to have as many [[Hunter (Tactics Advance)|Hunters]] as possible, when trying to capture a Goblin.
